description:
Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client

The Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client. Chat freely, create boldly, and bring ideas to life.
MiMo conversations now sync between desktop and mobile, with remote control available through Feishu, Lark, WeChat, WeCom, and Slack.
Remote sessions support file and media sharing, conversation switching, plan approvals, and responses to multiple questions.
Automation schedules and validity periods can be configured visually, with options to keep the app awake.
MiMo Open Platform accounts sync API and Token Plan usage, and API Key and Token Plan connections can coexist.
Markdown shortcuts now format as messages are composed, and changed files can be opened for clearer review.
Performance improvements for a smoother experience.
Fixed several known issues.
source: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
